check.description: Motion animation triggered by interaction can be disabled (respect prefers-reduced-motion) unless essential.

sources.internal_policy_ref: HSBC digital accessibility framework — WCAG 2.2 AA minimum, governed by Group Digital Experience and Accessibility (mandatory on all HSBC digital projects).

verified_by.mechanism: Every reference snippet is scanned for transition/animation/@keyframes usage; if present, a prefers-reduced-motion escape hatch is required. Gates the build per snippet (= per component).
